title: Checkout не працює
story: Пʼятниця, 17:45. Оновлення сертифіката зламало виклик checkout до payments. Критичний інцидент відкрито 4 хвилини тому.

expected.reason: checkout не працює, зачепить ще 2 сервіси

incidents.title: checkout not ready: TLS handshake to payments fails
incidents.rca: Rotated certificate on payments is signed by a CA the checkout trust store does not contain; every call to payments fails with x509 unknown authority.
investigationPlan: roll back payments cert secret to previous version
add new CA to checkout trust bundle

steps: token cache hit rate drops below 60%
